description:
## Problem
`CacheManager#get` checks `@config.load` (the read path), but `CacheManager#set` does NOT call `@config.save` (the write path). Users who only look at CacheManager would expect symmetry. The actual save happens earlier in `ImageProcessor::Default#process_bytes`, making the data flow hard to follow.

`CacheCoordinator#store_to_cache` calls both `@memory_cache.set` and `@cache_manager.set`, but neither triggers the user's `on_save` callback.

## Files
- `src/vug/cache_manager.cr` (lines 17-22)
- `src/vug/cache_coordinator.cr` (lines 17-20)

## Fix
Either:
1. Document the asymmetry clearly in CacheManager (the save happens in ImageProcessor), or
2. Make CacheManager#set call @config.save for proper symmetry.

Option 1 is safer — avoids double-save if ImageProcessor already called it.

## Acceptance
- Clear documentation on data flow for cache persistence
- No double-save regression
- Tests pass
title: CacheManager write-path asymmetry: set does not call on_save callback
